aboutPage.name: Mohammed Ashraf
aboutPage.bio1: A full-stack developer who builds and ships production web applications — e-commerce platforms, accounting and billing systems, and the interfaces sitting on top of them.
aboutPage.bio2: My work runs from React, Next.js, and Tailwind on the front through Supabase, Convex, and PostgreSQL behind it. What I care about most is the unglamorous half: database schema design, authentication and access control, and the performance details users actually feel.
aboutPage.bio3: I came to engineering from medicine. I studied it at the Islamic University of Gaza before switching to Computer Systems Engineering at Al-Azhar, and the habits carried over — read carefully, work from evidence, and don't guess when you can check.
aboutPage.bio4: Alongside client work I teach frontend at Zero to Hero. In April 2026 I joined Palestine AI Week with Palestine TechnoPark and Gaza Sky Geeks, working across two AI product teams — CivicMind, and Bookshelf, a reading app that summarises books and recommends what to read next. I'm currently extending my backend range with Laravel.
